subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should `registerMemoryPromptPreparation` become the durable public plugin-SDK lifecycle contract for asynchronous memory prompt state, after the missing CLI and resolved-agent propagation are repaired?
rationale: This PR adds a new public plugin lifecycle seam rather than only relocating Memory Wiki implementation state; the protected `maintainer` label and SDK compatibility boundary require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle API
options.body: Keep the public preparation seam, require the two runtime-path repairs and focused compatibility tests, then approve it as the canonical SDK contract.

options.title: Keep preparation private for now
options.body: Rework the change so Memory Wiki uses an existing supported seam until maintainers choose a broader public async memory lifecycle API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Keep the public preparation seam, require the two runtime-path repairs and focused compatibility tests, then approve it as the canonical SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows direct ownership of the proposed API and its Memory Wiki integration, making this contributor the best available routing candidate for the design discussion.
